_comment: Top-level keys of the frontend FilterState (frontend/src/components/Board/FilterBar.tsx; EMPTY_FILTER plus the optional laneFilter, #2205). Shared by backend test_saved_filters.py (pinned against SavedFilterSerializer._STATE_V1_KEYS) and frontend src/test/savedFilterKeysParity.test.ts so a key added on one side fails CI until the other follows (#2213). laneFilterLimits (#2205) pins the lane-filter bounds on both sides; laneBuiltinFields (#2336) pins the built-in lane rule fields. healthStatusValues (#2247) pins the health status enum against HealthStatus.values, and laneFilterOps (#2247) the lane rule op list against SavedFilterSerializer._LANE_OPS. laneFilterKeys (#2214) pins the keys of the laneFilter object itself. parentFilterMaxId (#2209) pins the Parent filter id bound. plannedFilterValues (#2550) pins the Planned filter enum. numberFilterOps / numberFilterValidEntries (#2357) pin the number custom-field operator enum and entries both sides must accept.
